title: Reach a self-hosted server over a LAN or Tailscale
when: A teammate connects from a different machine on a private network.
need: Initialize with --listen and connect to the printed reachable private address. The token travels unencrypted over HTTP; use Tailscale or a VPN, or add TLS on shared LANs. Public HTTP requires HTTPS.
surface: Self-host init output, connect help and self-host guides
review: Source regression tests cover the policy and transport; deployed private-network proof remains pending.
